businesses.business: Outpatient physical therapy and workplace injury prevention

offering_description.value: Provides outpatient physical and occupational therapy to patients recovering from injuries, surgery, and other conditions through a network of clinics. It also sends clinicians to employer worksites to prevent and address injuries and manages physical therapy facilities for healthcare organizations.

primary_services.value: Outpatient physical and occupational therapy; on-site workplace injury prevention and rehabilitation; ergonomic assessments; employment testing; physical therapy clinic management

customer_segment.value: B2C: Patients recovering from surgery or injury or receiving care for musculoskeletal and neurological conditions; B2B: Employers, hospitals, and physician groups

end_markets.value: Outpatient rehabilitation; occupational health and workplace safety

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Commercial insurance, government health programs, and workers’ compensation payments for therapy visits; service fees: Patient copays and self-pay visits, plus clinic management fees; project or contract: Employer contracts for on-site injury prevention, rehabilitation, and ergonomic services
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses licensed clinicians to provide rehabilitation to patients and injury prevention services to employers; asset operator: Operates outpatient clinics that treat referred and self-referred patients

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with clinics and employer worksites across multiple regions

specialization.value: related lines: Outpatient rehabilitation, workplace injury prevention, and physical therapy clinic management

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Outpatient clinics serving referred and self-referred patients; direct sales: Contracts with employers for services delivered at their worksites; other: Referrals from physicians and other healthcare providers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State licensure for therapy professionals and Medicare enrollment and billing requirements

notes: The current scope of third-party clinic management is uncertain.
